DitherTreemap.title: Headline on the top left.
DitherTreemap.items: The tiles, each { label, value, color, fill, detail, remainder }. A transparent color takes the next colour of the series.
DitherTreemap.capacity: The whole, in the same unit as the values.
DitherTreemap.status: Text in the footer while nothing is hovered.
DitherTreemap.replay-label: Text of the button that plays the animation again.
DitherTreemap.duration: How long the values take to grow in.
DitherTreemap.animated: false shows the finished treemap at once.
DitherTreemap.interactive: Hover a tile for the tooltip and the dimming.
DitherTreemap.spotlight: opacity dims the other tiles, none leaves them.
DitherTreemap.matrix: The dither pattern of the gradient fills.
DitherTreemap.header: Show the title and the readout.
DitherTreemap.readout: Show the used and total values and the percentage in the header.
DitherTreemap.footer: Show the status line and the replay button.
